text:
Anya: Quick FYI — kicking off a microseed prune to prep the promptset for the new model bring-up. Goal: prune near-duplicates from the microseed bank, surface ~3.2k candidate samples, and carve a 200-item micro-golden for early regression checks.

Raj: Nice. What are the exact sampling/prune criteria?

Anya: Using fuzzyhash dedupe + semantic overlap. Plan: remove candidates with fuzzy_sim >= 0.95 to any existing anchor; keep all labeled anchors; stratify remaining by intent frequency. Canary first (300 samples) then full run.

Matt: Labeling capacity check — we have 4 labelers available this sprint. Each can do ~500/day if pool is clean. That gives ~2k/day peak. ETA for 3.2k ~= 2 days with 2-day buffer.

Fran: For the micro-golden: propose 200 items with distribution: 40 high-risk intents, 40 long-context, 40 code-ish, 40 ambiguous, 40 multimodal-text. Keep provenance and source URL in metadata. Also include a small adversarial set (20) flagged for hallucination tests.

Raj: Can you paste the sampling command so I can reproduce?

Anya: Sure — the core command I'm running on staging:

```
python tools/microseed_prune.py \
  --seedbank microseed_v2 \
  --out s3://redwood-pruned/microseed_v2_pruned.jsonl \
  --fuzzy-threshold 0.95 \
  --semantic-model embed-small-v1 \
  --stratify-by intent,ctx_len,source \
  --sample 3200 \
  --canary 300
```

Matt: Cool. Where will the sample land for labelers?

Anya: Landing path is s3://redwood-label-jobs/microseed_prune/1764209999/. Each item has fields: id, prompt, source, intent_tag, fuzzy_hash, embed_hash, provenance. Label UI job will reference that path.

labeler-bot: labeler_queue status: pending_jobs=1, running_jobs=5, avg_completion=4h; workers_online=[Mike, Jess, Lina, Omar].

Ops-SRE: Heads-up — sampling job spawns a k8s batch job that needs efs mounted for local cache (path /mnt/seedcache). If you want GPU accel for embedding extraction, request nodepool=qembed. Otherwise CPU-only is fine. I can pre-create the job spec.

Anya: Ops-SRE — please create the k8s job with efs and 2 CPUs/8GB mem, nodepool qembed for canary (to speed up embed step).

Ops-SRE: Ack — will create canary job and post job id.

Fran: For golden labeling: labelers should mark each item with: 1) gold_ok / gold_bad, 2) failure_reason (hallucination/incomplete/PII), 3) freeform notes. We'll use that to freeze the 200 micro-golden set.

Mike: I can take the first canary batch (300) + 200 golden seed labeling. Will start tomorrow morning.

Jess: I can help with ambiguous & long-context buckets.

Anya: Sweet — volunteers noted. Plan:
- Run canary (300) after k8s job created
- Labelers (Mike, Jess, Lina, Omar) to process canary within 24h
- Collate labels, surface disagreements > 15% for adjudication
- Freeze 200-item micro-golden from highest-disagreement + risk buckets
- Kick full prune -> 3200 and label remainder in batches

Raj: One question — do we store embedding snapshots for future regressions?

Anya: Yes — embed snapshot + fuzzy hashes saved alongside each item. We'll version under s3://redwood-embeds/microseed_v2/1764209999/. Marking that as required for eval harness.

Ops-SRE: Canary job created: job_id=job-176420A. EFS mount done. Nodepool=qembed used for embeddings. Link to logs: https://k8s-logs.internal/job-176420A

labeler-bot: Job update: canary_uploaded=300, labeling_jobs_created=3

Fran: Small note — ensure we run the quantized model smoke tests against micro-golden too (int4 and int8) to catch any quantization-induced regressions early.

Anya: Agreed. After golden freeze we'll run smokes on quant variants and baseline.

Matt: Let's also add a quick eval with the new reranker in the loop (if compute permits) — reranker can change top candidate ranking for multi-turns.

Anya: Added to action list. Final action items:
- Ops-SRE: monitor canary job + post logs (in progress)
- Mike/Jess/Lina/Omar: label canary within 24h, tag disagreements
- Fran: prepare golden selection rubric doc and share link
- Raj: add sampling command to reproducibility notebook and pin embed model
- Matt: schedule quant smoke runs once golden is frozen

Anya: Thanks all — will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
